g.text: MOSAIC RESCUE / 12

text.style: fill: #163344; font: 700 25px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: A rescue claim has to survive every gate.

text.style: fill: #536572; font: 12px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Proposed decision rules for preclinical experiments. No arm has passed these gates in this case.

text.style: fill: #536572; font: 9px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: READING GUIDE · Schematic, not a new measurement · Sources and limits: docs/STORYBOARD.md

text.style: fill: #00695c; font: 700 11px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: 01 / ENGAGEMENT

text.style: fill: #163344; font: 700 16px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Does the proposed molecular change occur?

text.style: fill: #536572; font: 13px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: No → the proposed route is unsupported.

text.style: fill: #00695c; font: 700 11px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: 02 / FUNCTION

text.style: fill: #163344; font: 700 16px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Does chromosome segregation improve?

text.style: fill: #536572; font: 13px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: No → more protein or viability is insufficient.

text.style: fill: #00695c; font: 700 11px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: 03 / SAFETY

text.style: fill: #163344; font: 700 16px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Do unstable cells gain clonogenic survival?

text.style: fill: #a43a35; font: 13px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Yes → veto, even if another readout improves.

text.style: fill: #00695c; font: 700 11px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: 04 / INTERPRETABILITY

text.style: fill: #163344; font: 700 16px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Are viability and controls interpretable?

text.style: fill: #536572; font: 13px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: No → repeat or redesign; do not call rescue.

text.style: fill: #86520b; font: 700 11px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: CONTROLS ARE PART OF THE EXPERIMENT

text.style: fill: #163344; font: 12px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Vehicle · genetic rescue control · matched euploid/aneuploid context · direct molecular readout
